supersedes.reason: Breaking TX BUSY preamble-start and CRC-validated RX HeaderValid timestamp reference; all wire headers, context and authentication domains change.

wire.context_reference: 128-bit HMAC(PTOBR8C5, group context + immutable companion bytes0..65)
wire.stream: nonzero monotonic uint64 per unpredictable nonzero emitter boot; no wrap
wire.sequence: nonzero uint32 timing packets only; no wrap; metadata never resets floor
wire.own_gm_boots: root factory equals emitter; logical root boot and physical emitter boot independently exact, may differ
wire.no_source: Companion only; emitter+boot+stream nonzero, all root/parent/epoch zero, scale0/kind0, mandatory TIME_INVALID; strict timing/export validator rejects.

optional_name.padding: zero from end of name through byte63
optional_name.validation: existing group-name UTF-8 rules, nonempty; sequence and context nonzero
optional_name.meaning: descriptive immediate emitter label only; no scope/time/authority

tz.format: uint16 LE id, int16 LE offset minutes
tz.changes: coalesced background companion; unknown clears; no precision authority

policy.listener_settx_allowed: Only authenticated current-context source invitation, LoRa selected/no usable BLE, bounded optional measurement; no source transmission.
policy.metadata_refresh: Latest coalesced source/TZ, nominal120s and change events, >=2s gap, source timing first; no catch-up.
policy.cache_replacement: Same boot requires increasing stream and nondecreasing timing floor; different boot may restart sequence after12s gap; immediately retired context/boot rejected. Timing partial scope may acquire without companion, UNKNOWN.
policy.anchor_policy: unqualified assumed bounds; no RC8 renewal; expiry degrades assurance without stopping functional stream
policy.allow_unverified: explicit selection argument; permitted when BLE unusable; no RC7/GM/RC9 permission
policy.cold_acquisition: Two physical timing packets suffice; boots/stream/parent/quality remain UNKNOWN until matching companion; absolute freshness remains UNKNOWN.
policy.diagnostic_withdrawal: Only exact current context, increasing diagnostic sequence and timing floor >= current highest; clears sample/history without renewing hold.
policy.context_repeat: One coalesced repeat after each new context; replaces old pending repeat, timing priority, no catch-up.
policy.parent_quality_age: Conservative accepted causal HELLO seen age, connected/authenticated/map-valid exact peer and quality identity; known bits clear at10s; oldest included datum sets snapshot age; polls never renew.
policy.name_scope: Accept only matching current full authenticated companion context and newer name sequence; never adopt or complete context from name. Clear on OFF, fault, context replacement or valid withdrawal; no timing/history/lease renewal.
policy.sole_source_transmitter: privately enrolled exact factory identity; never alias

phy_calculation.occupancy_limits: Existing total_occupancy_percent is baseline timing+companion only. Names/events/deferrals vary actual occupation; no coexistence or regional qualification.

memory.role_union: One bounded760B exclusive RX/TX union; RX fit80B includes same-context relative fit provenance.

display_metadata_addition.scope: all added name/RSSI/activity/display-deadline/fit-provenance state including copied views
display_metadata_addition.count: linked writable symbols in all four affected translation units; complete native static margin also checked

stage2_tz_addition.count: all four linked translation units including copied views, complete native RAM margin >=1024B; stacks/buffers unchanged

gesture.runtime_toggle: Open menu, short press advances, separate2s hold selects once; Exit/5s idle closes
gesture.legacy_helper: portable rc8_gesture_update only; ordinary runtime controls use shared watch menu

runtime.metadata_control_guard_us: length-specific FEM bound +1000us, driver repeats immediately before FEM
runtime.map_commit: captured physical publication linearization; original anchors and deadlines immutable
runtime.radio_fault: First transport/capture failure retained; bounded journal attempt and existing physical watchdog reset; unretired DMA never reused; partial init routes inhibited; ordinary stop releases capture/group before common timer closure.
runtime.follower_tx_gate: currently usable authenticated selected BLE delivered-map PLL locked; local PPS/source_ready not required
runtime.own_gm_tx_gate: currently valid qualified own PPS/source map

display_continuation.time: coarse display only; bounded original physical RX/TX pair

runtime_link_fit.statistic: population affine residual RMS of original physical RX tick / exact corrected TX ns pairs; relative only

display_rollover_cache.requires: same context/capture epoch, current original12s physical timing input, no actual fit reset
display_rollover_cache.use: last completed fit only while next nonoverlapping block has fewer than4 pairs
display_rollover_cache.provenance: original last-pair timestamp, timing sequence and fit population; never relabelled as new-block fit

software_launch_abort.sequence: consume proposed timing or diagnostic sequence once

gm_coordination.inhibit: accepted authenticated foreign-root physical pair; original functional hold only; root boot may be unknown
gm_coordination.root: original GM factory/boot/source epoch; immediate BLE parent is route provenance
gm_coordination.eligibility: matching full root boot plus current authenticated direct-root JOIN and captured BLE map, or live admitted direct-root control with causal map; source/HOT guards still apply
gm_coordination.selection: canonical root only while live; no local quality, old pair or alternative-root override
gm_coordination.metadata: does not create or renew hold; TIME_INVALID and context change withdraw matched sample
gm_coordination.self_echo: no timing samples; only separately proved current serving origin incarnation/epoch plus same-emitter-boot strictly newer full self-root companion may retire old full foreign constraint; no admission/promotion; cold/inactive/old boot/epoch/replay cannot
gm_coordination.expiry: ordinary source readmission and output fences
limits: UNKNOWN passive freshness; cold replay can inhibit
no RC7 timing/USB authority or GM promotion
no global single-GM proof across complete RF partitions
gm_coordination.handover: current direct authenticated explicit root-source withdrawal may complete ordinary ACTIVE replacement after old service permit and existing takeover/output fences; silence/map expiry alone cannot

probe.offer: client/boot zero; nonzero salt in nonce; t2 latest timing sequence; t3 admission hash bits0..12
probe.request: exact client/boot/nonce and offer; t2/t3 zero
probe.response: echo transaction with original source request RX_HEADER ns in t2; t3 zero
probe.follow: same t2 plus actual response TX_START ns in t3
probe.state: one globally pending transaction; no queue or peer roster; silence/expiry/refusal healthy
probe.authority: local LoRa watch only in GM or RC; no BLE/GNSS estimator, USB source, RC7/RC9, serving/election/HOT permission
probe.causal_ingress: Preserve original physical request RX map before turnover, validate exact RX_DONE tick/epoch/generation, never use later formula; processing consumes original transaction lifetime.
probe.cache_lifetime: Original finite same-context physical link delay; source withdrawal stops time but does not renew or erase the cache. Fresh physical timing required for recovery. Context/capture changes, OFF, fault and expiry clear it.

rf_events.tx: SX1262 BUSY falling after committed SetTx: PA ramp complete and preamble start, §8.3.1/9.6.1
rf_events.rx: SX1262 DIO1 first HeaderValid rising; packet accepted only with same single-RX HeaderValid|RxDone and no header/CRC/timeout error
rf_events.capture: Allocated GPIOTE IN -> PPI -> shared16MHz TIMER3 CC4; fork disables own allocated PPI group on first edge; never ISR/poll timestamp
rf_events.tx_attribution: Arm after DMA SetTx bytes retire and before actual NSS commit, BUSY low. Preserve generation and original capture incarnation; completion requires exact TxDone flags. No subsequent command before completion.
rf_events.rx_attribution: HeaderValid stays asserted until DONE/error; do not clear/rearm midpacket; missing HeaderValid and mixed errors drop healthily; original physical-header450ms completion limit
rf_events.fem: Separate DIO1 -> CSD-clear route TX only; independent TIMER4 cutoff unchanged. Early RX edge never clears FEM.
rf_events.uncertainty: RX_HEADER is a decoded modem marker, not a documented chirp-arrival boundary. No specified RF-to-DIO/PA-to-antenna calibration. Measured RTT includes fixed header/detection and directional modem delay; never distance.
rf_events.no_reconstruction: No observed1.64ms constant, symbol-airtime subtraction, software launch time or inferred RF epoch
rf_events.resources: One additional allocated GPIOTE input and one allocated PPI channel/group; no new timer/CC/thread/ticker, stacks and radio buffers unchanged
